'''Sara Ornelas''' is a voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Ornelas was born in Texas and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where she voiced minor recurring character [[Yansu]]. She later started voicing [[Mallow's mother]]. Ornelas is currently affiliated with Sentai Filmworks.
